systems.platform: paper questionnaire, then SurveyCTO electronic forms (CAPI) on tablets with a web-based data repository
systems.owner: MBSSE Directorate of Planning and Policy and its EMIS Unit, supported by the World Bank, EU, GPE, FCDO and Irish Aid
systems.tiers: all pre-primary, primary, junior and senior secondary schools, public and private, in 16 districts (12,466 schools in 2022); school authorities fill a paper questionnaire a week ahead, enumerators visit and key it into the tablet form and count pupils present; collected 7 December 2022 to 13 January 2023

systems.country_label: EMIS (EMIS Unit; EMIS server; EMIS number)
systems.tiers: the unit that produces the census data, and a school identifier (EMIS number); the report recommends that school heads in future complete school records on tablets and submit them to the EMIS server, which they do not yet do

note: Passages of a census report: it describes only the yearly return, keyed by visiting enumerators. Unique IDs for all learners are given as 'the next move' and school heads' own digital entry as the future; neither is a system in use, and the passages make no explicit statement that learner records are on paper only, so no fact is taken.
